narration.full_text: Welcome to our lesson on trigonometry! Today, we'll cover several key objectives to build your understanding of this essential mathematical concept. First, we'll define the fundamental trigonometric ratios within the context of a right-angled triangle. You'll learn how to identify and express sine, cosine, and tangent, along with their reciprocals. Next, we'll practice calculating all the trigonometric ratios for an angle, even if you're only given one. This skill is crucial for solving various trigonometric problems. We'll then explore how to prove angle equality using these ratios, demonstrating their power in geometric proofs. Finally, we'll delve into evaluating trigonometric identities and understanding the application of reciprocal identities, which are vital for simplifying expressions and solving equations. By the end of this session, you'll have a solid foundation in these core trigonometric principles.
